reviews.text: Britney did such a great job on my hair. Very professional. Very knowledgeable. A repeat customer for sure.
Lawrence is amazing! I can't say enough good things about his service and how much he cares about each client. The whole business is clean, organized, and everyone is so friendly.

Shandrea is amazing! In love with my hair every time. She gives my hair life & brings it back to looking shiny & healthy. Won't trust no one else with my hair. Highly recommend comimg to her. Also the salon just has such good vibes. Friendly, clean & relaxing. Love this salon!
